propositions: The plan-review gate has no criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, resulting in 35-65% over-action rate in FixedBench that lacks review counterpart.
Bug tickets are gate-exempt and short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (zero LLM calls, no findings).
A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate change is needed (no reproduction or motivation), accepting well-motivated and docs-test-only outcomes.
Bug review must transition from full exemption to a lightweight advisory tier consisting of deterministic floor checks plus the necessity probe, never blocking a bug.
The necessity criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and appear in criteria_routing.json with default_posture advisory and no bug suppress_types to apply to bug tickets.
The bug-tier lifecycle must run DET floor + necessity probe advisory-only (det_blocking empty) via workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck and restrict included criteria to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA.
